enabled.name: Enable Hover Labels
enabled.hint: Master switch. When disabled, Foundry's default single tooltips are used everywhere.

sidebar.name: Label Sidebar Buttons
sidebar.hint: Hovering a sidebar button shows the labels of all sidebar buttons.

sceneControls.name: Label Scene Controls
sceneControls.hint: Which scene control buttons show all of their labels when hovered.

clickableLabels.name: Clickable Labels
clickableLabels.hint: Clicking a label activates its button. (Scene layer labels are never clickable, as they would cover the tools.)

highlightHovered.name: Highlight Hovered Label
highlightHovered.hint: Highlight the label that belongs to the button you are hovering.

animate.name: Animate Labels
animate.hint: Fade and slide labels in and out.

showDelay.name: Show Delay (ms)
showDelay.hint: How long to hover before labels appear. 0 shows them immediately.

hideDelay.name: Hide Delay (ms)
hideDelay.hint: How long labels stay after the cursor leaves the area.
